backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a contact form submission system with admin-only viewing (with filtering/sorting), user profile management, and role-based access control via MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the four downloadable resource items in Resources.tsx have been linked to their respective external URLs with target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, components, hooks, and configuration files for the Sanatani-themed React application.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar, etc.) using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the KATTAR SANATANI YODHA app, including Google Site Verification meta tag, root div, and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/public/ads.txt: Google AdSense ads.txt file declaring a direct relationship with publisher ID pub-4905807488237044.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with eight routes (home, about, programs, philosophy, resources, contact, donate, admin) under a shared Layout.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying the organization logo/name, Hindi quick links, contact details (email, phones, location), and social media icons (Facebook, X, WhatsApp, YouTube).
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section component with a full-screen background image, Sanskrit tagline, Hindi mission statement, and CTA buttons for supporting the mission and learning more.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper component that renders Navigation and Footer around the routed page content via an Outlet.
frontend/src/components/Mission.tsx: Mission section displaying four core value cards (भक्ति, रक्षा, ज्ञान, एकता) with icons and Hindi descriptions in a responsive grid.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Responsive navigation bar component with Hindi nav links, active route highlighting, mobile hamburger menu, and a conditional admin link shown only to authenticated admin users.
frontend/src/components/ProgramCard.tsx: Simple card component that displays a Lucide icon, title, and description for a program entry with hover animation.
frontend/src/components/SupportOptions.t: Displays a 2x2 grid of support option cards (volunteer, spread awareness, contribute skills, share knowledge) with icons and links to the contact page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using TanStack Query, initializing it with the user's Internet Identity or anonymously, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Hook that manages contact form submission state (submitting, success, error) and calls the backend actor's submitContactForm method.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports TanStack Query hooks for fetching all contact submissions, checking if the caller is an admin, and retrieving the current user's profile from the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, defines a Sanatani-inspired saffron/warm OKLCH color palette for light and dark modes via CSS variables, and sets up Tailwind base/component/utility layers with custom gradient and pattern utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: About page with a hero section, organization story paragraphs in Hindi, and a grid of four principle cards (mission, vision, values, community).
frontend/src/pages/Admin.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays all contact form submissions in a searchable, filterable table with CSV export functionality, restricted to authenticated admin users via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a Hindi-language form (name, email, message) that submits via useContactForm hook, alongside contact info and social media links.
frontend/src/pages/Donate.tsx: Donation/support page showing support options via SupportOptions component, impact area breakdowns with progress bars, and a transparency commitment section, all in Hindi.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page composing Hero and Mission components with a highlights grid of four focus areas and a call-to-action section linking to donate and contact pages.
frontend/src/pages/Philosophy.tsx: Philosophy page presenting Sanatan Dharma teachings in Hindi, covering its eternal nature, devotion (bhakti), and exemplary figures like Ram, Hanuman, and Yudhishthira.
frontend/src/pages/Programs.tsx: Programs page listing six initiative cards (Vedic study, cultural festivals, youth education, community gatherings, social welfare, heritage preservation) with impact statistics, rendered in Hindi.
frontend/src/pages/Resources.tsx: React page component displaying a Hindi-language resources library with four category cards (sacred texts, video lectures, articles, downloadable materials) and four featured resources with external download/view links.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routing, persist them to sessionStorage, and clean sensitive parameters from the URL hash without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based colors (saffron, gold, terracotta), custom font families (Inter, Cormorant Garamond, Cinzel), warm box shadows, and accordion/fade-in keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file (version 15) recording the goal of translating the app into Hindi, the admin principal ID, known deployment issues with Hindi translations not taking effect, and a list of completed translation feature IDs per component/page.
